latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the api-gateway skill, enabling secure, OAuth-managed connections to 100+ third-party APIs via Maton.

- Provides passthrough proxy to native API endpoints for popular services (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack, Notion, GitHub, Airtable, etc.)
- Secure access via Maton API key; user grants explicit OAuth authorization for each connected service
- Supports connection management: list, create, get, and delete connections through dedicated endpoints
- Allows specifying connections using the Maton-Connection header when multiple connections exist
- Includes comprehensive documentation and code samples for quick integration
